description:
The USPTO is performing market research for professional media communication services which may include, but are not limited:

  • Drafting media strategies and communications plans for USPTO;
  • Drafting press releases and media advisories;
  • Supporting media relations and coordinating interviews, when applicable;
  • Monitoring media coverage and providing reports;
  • Producing content for social media, USPTO staff communications, and USPTO internet postings;
  • Training for USPTO staff on social media, communication strategies, and other related topics; and
  • Assessing USPTO’s communication skillsets and performing a gap analysis to determine needed skillsets.
